simple.meaning: שַׁאֲנָן (shaʼănân) is a Hebrew word meaning “secure ; in a bad sense, haughty.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שַׁאֲנָן (H7600) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Kings 19:28, with occurrences in 2 Kings, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Amos, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁאֲנָן (H7600) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שַׁאֲנָן (H7600) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שַׁאֲנָן (shaʼănân) / H7600 is traced through 2 Kings 19:28, Job 12:5, Psalms 123:4, Isaiah 32:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’

timeline.evidenceText: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’
In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease,
Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice!
Tremble, you women who are at ease!
My people will live in a peaceful habitation,
Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals.

Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
Woe to those who are at ease in Zion,
I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

definitions.short: secure ; in a bad sense, haughty
definitions.usage: that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare 7946 .
definitions.full: H7600. shaanan שַׁאֲנָן adjective at ease, secure (Ba NB § 143a Ges § 84 b k ); — absolute ׳שׁ Isa 33:20 ; plural שַׁאֲנִּים Amos 6:1 +, שַׁאֲנַנּוֺת Isa 32:9 , 11 , 18 ; — 1 at ease, secure: שׁ ׳נָוֶה Isa 33:20 , secure habitation (of Jerusalem), compare שׁ ׳מְנוּחוֺת 32:18 (|| מִבְטָחִים ). 2 as substantive , one at ease , free from misfortune, Job 12:5 . 3 at ease , with collateral idea of careless, wanton, arrogant , Amos 6:1 ; Isa 32:9 , 11 ; Zech 1:15 ; Psa 123:4 . 4 as substantive abstract = arrogance: suffix שַׁאֲנַנְךָ , 2Kin 19:28 (|| הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ ) = Isa 37:29 , but < שְׁאוֺנְךָ thine uproar , Bu ZAW xii (1892), 36 Gr Che Marti Kit (perhaps), Bur. compare שׁלאנן .
